output.reason: The rendered diffs show that between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0, updaterequests.kyverno.io v1beta1.storage changes from true to false [ev-cf5b10ff8047] and v2.storage changes from false to true [ev-d3850c78b94e]. So environments upgrading from before 1.13.0 are the ones crossing the storage switch. According to the change text, only existing UpdateRequest objects still stored as v1beta1 need migrating. A gvk-in-use leaf would wrongly match on manifests rather than on stored objects.
